title: shipped 8 PRs today
summary: the seed upgrade workflow used to take 25 hours. rewrote it, now it takes seconds. also added dirtberry-pro for images, qwen3-tts for audio, and moved klein 4b to a dedicated pipeline. open source ai infrastructure continues. 🐝

highlights.title: Voice acting via system prompt
highlights.text: Seraphyn joined as a community provider, bringing `qwen3-tts` to the [Unified API](https://gen.pollinations.ai). You can now style the voice output just by describing what you want in the system prompt.

highlights.title: Dirtberry Pro
highlights.text: Added `dirtberry-pro` to the image model roster. Pass it as your model parameter when you need high realism and complex scenes.

highlights.title: Public user endpoint
highlights.text: We opened a restricted Tinybird pipe that safely exposes public profile and tier data. You can finally build those community leaderboards without leaking secrets.

highlights.title: Gratisfy integration
highlights.text: Pollinations is now hooked up to Gratisfy, letting you access our endpoints alongside other free AI providers through a single unified API.
